# Handoff Summary

## System Health: ✅ Running Normally

| Metric | Champion (v5) | Last PASS Candidate |
|--------|---------------|---------------------|
| Tuning Mean | **1.90** | 1.76 |
| Tuning Min | **0.43** | 0.05 ⚠️ |
| Lockbox Mean | 1.79 | 1.79 |
| Lockbox Min | 1.13 | **1.35** ✓ |
| Worst MDD | **-9.3%** | -11.2% |

## Key Observations

1. **Champion holds** - v5_latest maintains better risk-adjusted profile (higher tuning min, tighter drawdown)

2. **Candidate trade-off** - `exp_macro_alpha_shadow` shows improved lockbox robustness (+0.22 min) but significantly worse tuning stability (0.05 vs 0.43) and drawdown (-11.2% vs -9.3%)

3. **Pipeline status** - 110 loops in ~12h, no stuck INCONCLUSIVE candidates, healthy iteration rate

## Recommendation

**Continue automated loop** - The suggested commands are appropriate:
```bash
# Run these in sequence
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --run --select-best
python3 experiment_system/tools/system_autopilot.py --spec experiment_system/config/system_candidates.yaml --run
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_next_fix.py --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml --output baseline/reports/next_fix.md
```

**Watch for**: Candidates that improve lockbox min while maintaining tuning min > 0.3 and worst_mdd > -10%
